using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;
vector<int> factorial;

int modExp(int base, long long exp) {
    int res = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
            res = (int) ((res * 1LL * base) % MOD);
        }
        base = (int) ((base * 1LL * base) % MOD);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long combination(int n, int r) {
    long long num = factorial[n];
    long long den = (factorial[n - r] * 1LL * factorial[r]) % MOD;
    return (num * modExp((int) den, MOD - 2)) % MOD;
}

class Pair {
public:
    int x, y;
    
    Pair(int x, int y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    
    bool operator<(const Pair& other) const {
        if (x != other.x) return x < other.x;
        return y < other.y;
    }
    
    bool operator==(const Pair& other) const {
        return x == other.x && y == other.y;
    }
    
    bool operator!=(const Pair& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }
};

namespace std {
    template<>
    struct hash<Pair> {
        size_t operator()(const Pair& p) const {
            return hash<int>()(p.x) ^ (hash<int>()(p.y) << 1);
        }
    };
}

int main() {
    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    if (k > n - 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;

    factorial.resize(n + 1);
    factorial[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        factorial[i] = (int) ((factorial[i - 1] * 1LL * i) % MOD);
    }
    
    int pop = n - (int) k;
    long long total = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= pop; i++) {
        long long term = (combination(pop, i) * modExp(pop - i, n)) % MOD;
        if (i % 2 == 1) {
            term = (MOD - term) % MOD;
        }
        total = (total + term) % MOD;
    }
    
    total = (total * combination(n, pop)) % MOD;
    if (k != 0) {
        total = (total * 2) % MOD;
    }
    
    cout << total << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
